summary: All 36 source hashes and sizes matched, and all 12 computations reproduced. Of 255 author discoveries, 184 paired uniquely with registered genes. The registered analysis called none significant by BH. The corrected proposal retains the existing comparison specification because the proposed orientation multiplier does not occur in the ledger. It passed repository validation. Closure remains needs_author_contact.
openIssues: Figure 2C shows higher Fto expression in fed knockouts, and its legend reports four mice. The deposited table has three libraries per genotype and lower mean Fto expression in knockouts, 279.43 versus 317.03 CPM. The figure’s samples and calculation need author clarification. [Published Figure 2](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12403242/#F2)
The published methods and deposited statistics do not identify the original likelihood-ratio fit, dispersion estimation cohort, or exact filtering and qvalue settings.
The earlier DE snapshot was unavailable. The 71 currently unpaired author discoveries were verified individually. The identities of the historical 70 remain unverified.
